name: The frigate Ertuğrul to Japan
traveler: Osman Pasha and the crew of the Ertuğrul
summary: Sultan Abdülhamid II sends an old wooden frigate to return the visit of a Japanese prince, carrying the Order of Osmanié to the Meiji emperor. The voyage takes eleven months. On the way home a typhoon drives the ship onto the rocks off Kushimoto: more than five hundred men drown. The villagers of Ōshima save sixty-nine, and two Japanese warships carry them home.

stops.note: About six hundred men sail under Osman Pasha.
Through the canal to the Red Sea.
The old ship is taking water at the bow.
Months of repairs; she sails on 22 March.
About ten days in French Cochinchina.
Osman Pasha presents the Order to the Meiji emperor in Tokyo.
Sailing home into a typhoon, she breaks up on the rocks of Kashinozaki. The people of Ōshima carry the survivors from the sea.
The sixty-nine survivors come home on the Japanese warships Hiei and Kongō.

informs.note: Meiji Japan, and the kindness of the people of Ōshima
